images.title: Read a Mayan numeral
images.purpose: Shows a Mayan numeral read from the bottom up: one bar, three dots, two dots give 5 + 60 + 720 = 785.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One vertical stack of three levels in the centre, place names on the left and values on the right, the total at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Three levels stacked one above another with even gaps. Top level: exactly 2 dots in a row. Middle level: exactly 3 dots in a row. Bottom level: exactly 1 horizontal bar. Dots and bars in teal (#0072B2). Left of the levels, in grey (#6B7280), top to bottom: 360s, 20s, 1s. Right of the levels, in amber (#E69F00), top to bottom: 720, 60, 5. Below the stack, larger: 785. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Mayan numerals stack places upward: 1s at the bottom, then 20s, then 360s.
images.description: Shows a Mayan numeral read from the bottom up: one bar, three dots, two dots give 5 + 60 + 720 = 785.
images.context: Dot 1, bar 5, shell for an empty place; landmarks 1, 20, 360, 7200; 2 × 360 + 3 × 20 + 5 = 785.

image_decisions.why: A Mayan numeral is read by its stacked places, which a labelled stack shows at a glance.
